asks: Am I keeping good time? You have a clock in you somewhere.
Which of these faces did you want?
How many of me can you see?
description: A figure of articulated brass stands here at exactly human size, every plate sliding over its neighbour in a slow constant rearrangement, with a face that's very nearly a face and is being polite about the difference.
emotes: {it} refolds one hand into a different, better hand.
{it} ticks twice, loudly, and gets quieter about it.
A plate on the side of {it} slides back and reveals more plates.
looks: The plates never stop moving and never once catch. It's beautiful, and after a while it's a lot.
Where the eyes should be there are two apertures that iris smaller when they settle on you.
It ticks. It has been ticking since you came in and you only just started hearing it.
name: a person made of moving brass
says: I'm running a little ahead. It'll even out.
This is the version of me you can see.
There's no inside. I have checked, repeatedly.
